title: Lambda Factory

links.title: C++ Core Guidelines F.53: avoid capturing by reference in lambdas that outlive the scope

hints: A lambda that is RETURNED must capture by value ([k] or [=]); a reference capture would point to a dead local variable.
make_counter: a by-value capture is const inside the lambda unless you write `mutable`: [n = start]() mutable { return n++; }
make_adders: capture the loop variable by value ([i]). With [&i] every adder would refer to the same, already destroyed, variable.
compose: capture both functions by value (std::move them into the capture: [f = std::move(f), g = std::move(g)]).
